CustomField.label: Display: Expected Text
CustomField.description: Optional and display only. Plain text (not a formula) that overrides the auto-generated Expected line on a multi-row ("Every record passes") query check. Supports {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount} and {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount} plus {!record.FieldName} tokens. Example: every contact has an email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Display only. Plain text (not a formula) for the "Expected" line on an "Every record passes" check. Tokens: {!rhcResult.failedRecordCount}, {!rhcResult.totalRecordCount}, {!record.FieldName}.
